reviews.author: Venkatesh R.
reviews.text: Service Advisor Sanjay was very good and transparent. He clearly walked me through what needed attention without any pushy upselling. Car was delivered smooth and punctually on Basapura Main Road.

reviews.author: Arjun Nair
reviews.service: Car Air Conditioning Service & Cooling Coil Cleaning
reviews.text: My AC had completely stopped blowing cold air during peak Bangalore traffic. The team at Quality Motors diagnosed the refrigerant leakage, replaced the valve, and refilled gas. Super chilled cooling now!

reviews.author: Deepak Sharma
reviews.service: Brake System Service & Disc Rotor Resurfacing
reviews.text: Had persistent brake squeal and vibration on highway driving. They skimmed the rotors and fitted new brake pads. Very satisfied with Quality Motors - affordable rates compared to authorized showrooms.

reviews.author: Preeti Kulkarni
reviews.text: Check engine warning had popped up. Their technician identified the faulty oxygen sensor quickly with computerized scanner and fixed the harness. Professional and reliable workshop in Basapura.
